content: Cohere embed-multilingual-v3.0: $0.10-0.12/1M tokens, best-in-class non-English/non-Latin-script retrieval, ~15-20% better than OpenAI on non-Latin scripts per some benchmarks. Voyage-3: $0.06/1M tokens, voyage-3-large leads on some retrieval benchmarks. Both cost 3-6x more than OpenAI text-embedding-3-small for a single-user, low-volume workload.
